retention.stated: per-object-cap: unstated; scope is restrictive — statistical maps/parcellations/atlases only. Retention: permanent URLs

egress.terms: Free and anonymous. `neurovault.org/media/images/...` serves with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, no auth.

tooling: Documented REST API (`/api/images/?format=json`, `/api/collections/`), plus the `pynv`/`nilearn` fetch-atlas path. Upload needs an account but is API-driven.
chaining: Unlimited collections per account; each image is an independent anonymous object. The API exposes every image's `file` URL and `file_size`, so a caller can enumerate and pull the whole corpus without auth.
limits_note: per-object-cap: unstated; scope is restrictive — statistical maps/parcellations/atlases only. Retention: permanent URLs. Read limit: none observed, no CDN in front (bare origin), so throughput is modest.
